Those three preferences cover what I had in mind, and the options feel sufficient. “Show more” is a good, unobtrusive way to reveal additional links, and selecting all matching links must continue to include results not yet revealed.

I’d like these preferences to follow my library across devices rather than being tied to one browser. Changing the Sort dropdown temporarily should not overwrite my saved default; only changing Default order in Preferences should do that. With that adjustment, the display-preference behavior is right.
